column2: -2.2119646029042515 The Legend of Shipton's Grave https://www.stroudiecentral.co.uk/the-history-of-nailsworth-in-gloucestershire/ Shipton's Grave is a lonely roadside burial site at a crossroads near Barton End
column3: named after a tragic local man executed for stealing sheep to feed his starving family. His memorial at the intersection has long remained a haunting landmark along the ancient Cotswold ridgeway tracks. #crossroads-burial
